newsitem.title: CROATIA: Pliva to repurchase up to 5 pct of its stock.
newsitem.headline: Pliva to repurchase up to 5 pct of its stock.

text.p: Pliva d.d., Croatia's leading drugs firm, said on Monday it would seek approval from sharholders to repurchase up to five percent of the company's roughly 2.0 billion kuna ordinary stock.
Maximum purchase price would be five percent above a market average over 10 days before the repurchase on the London and Zagreb Stock Exchanges, it said in a press release.
Pliva is planning a 1-for-37 share split from January 1, 1997 whereby its ordinary registered shares would be reissued with a face value of 100 kuna each.

It is also proposing to appoint two more members, Massimo Armanini and Ettore d'Isola, to its supervisory board in addition to the current seven members. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
